notes.title: New Game Mode
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello there Urban Nightmare Runners![/b][/i]

We want to thank you all again for playing our game and giving us feedback, we genuinely enjoyed reading all the reviews and seeing your fastest times being posted on the community page! The team has been working very hard to add this new large update that adds more maps, better found footage theming, and quality of life changes. These maps will take your skills to the next level, testing your mastery of parkour. We hope that you enjoy this and please continue to post your new times for the new levels.

Here is a bite size list of what is coming within this update! Happy Free Running
[list]
[*] Overhaul of the UI to show the camera elements and create the "Found Footage" feel
[*] Several bug fixes known to cause crashes
[*] Fixed frame rate for consistent in-game experience
[*] Added save and level select system
[*] Added "Lost Footage" mode with the 5 original levels reimagined into more difficult versions
[/list]

notes.title: Small Content Update - 5/23/2024
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello there Urban Nightmare Runners![/b][/i]

We want to thank each of you for playing our game and giving us feedback, we genuinely enjoyed reading all the reviews and seeing your fastest times being posted on the community page! For this latest update, we were wanting to have a few updates to both the UI and replay-ability in the game.

[u]Here are the latest updates to the game:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Updated Player HUD[/b] - We wanted to really embrace the Found Footage aspect of the game so we finally added a HUD that would look more like what you would see in a head/body camera. 
[*] [b]Updated End scene[/b] - We polished the ending of the game to better fit with the new UI, communicate more of our story, and tease more to come in the game.
[*] [b]Added Level Select Screen [/b] - We realized that in order for players to replay levels to get faster times, they would need to replay the entire game from start to finish and that isn't what we wanted for you to have to deal with. So instead we opted to have a level unlocking system that not only unlocks levels you completed but also saves your fastest time so you can go back and replay it again with ease!
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon, and please keep leaving your great feedback! It really helps us to hear directly from our players what you do and don't like about the game.

notes.title: Small Patch Notes Update
notes.content:
Hey Urban Nightmarer's we come to you with an update to the game. Very Minor tweaks to make your experience more exciting!
[list]
[*] Polish in all levels
[*] Decrease death time
[*] Increase lighting / visibility and baked lighting quality
[*] Fixed clipping bugs
[/list]

May you get the fastest time and escape with precision!

notes.title: Upcoming Content Updates
notes.content:
Hey there Urban Nightmare Runners!

We are currently working on more bug fixes for the game as well as some quality of life improvements plus an update to the final level as a whole.

Below is a short comprehensive list of things to expect:
[list]
[*] Updated In-Game UI while player is running.
[*] Updated Final Level with end goal instead of fading to black once reaching the heart of the city.
[*] Game breaking crash when the player dies and then starts to perform a looping action.
[*] Level Select Screen so you can see your fastest time per level.
[/list]

We hope that you continue to post your fastest time in our community hub and share your recordings of how you achieved them!
